common.allow.description: Button that asks for a phone permission (location, camera).

common.app_name.description: App and programme name; brand, never translated.

common.audio_loading.description: Listen button while the audio loads.

common.audio_unavailable.description: Listen button when no recording exists for this screen or notice.

common.call_name.description: Call button naming the person. Wireframe has "సురేష్‌కు కాల్ చేయండి"; "గారికి" is used so the suffix fits any name, including names in Latin script.

common.close.description: Close button for sheets and dialogs.

common.coming_soon.description: Label on locked tiles and features not built yet.

common.date_full.description: A full date with year, e.g. "12 అక్టో, 2026". Use on consents and seasons.

common.date_short.description: A day and short month, e.g. "12 అక్టో". Use on list rows.

common.date_weekday.description: A date with short weekday and month, e.g. "గురు, 29 అక్టో". Use for visit dates.

common.done.description: Done button at the end of a flow.

common.dot_join.description: Joins two short facts on one line (wireframe style "Kondapur · Cotton").

common.helpline.description: Helpline label; the number comes from app config.

common.hours_ago.description: Relative time on cards (wireframe F5 "2 h ago").

common.listen.description: Listen button: plays the voice prompt or voice note.

common.open_settings.description: Button that opens the phone settings after a permission was denied.

common.retry.description: Retry button on error cards (wireframe F7b, F9c).

common.saved_at.description: Banner under cached data: when it was saved. Wireframe F2 "Saved at 7:00 am".

common.step_of.description: Step header in multi-step flows (one input per screen).

common.unknown.description: Shown when a value is missing or an enum value is new to this app version.

common.whatsapp.description: WhatsApp chat button; brand, never translated.

enum.advice_status.unresolved.description: Visit issue advice status: the FA will follow up.

enum.area_source.boundary.description: How a plot area was found.

enum.area_source.typed.description: How a plot area was found.

enum.language.en.description: Language chip; always shown in its own script (wireframe F1).

enum.language.te.description: Language chip; always shown in its own script (wireframe F1).

enum.notice_sender.civ.description: Notice source tag (wireframe F5); CIV full name is an open decision.

enum.notice_sender.system.description: Notice source tag for system notices.

enum.season_kind.kharif.description: First part of a season code (kharif-2026).

enum.season_kind.rabi.description: First part of a season code (rabi-2026-27).

enum.season_kind.summer.description: First part of a season code (summer-2026).

enum.season_status.abandoned.description: Season status and close-season outcome (crop lost or given up).

error.detail.attempts_left.description: Added after an error message when details.attempts_left is present (otp_invalid).

error.detail.retry_after_seconds.description: Added after an error message when the app puts the Retry-After seconds in details.retry_after_seconds.

error.device_revoked.description: 401 device_revoked: the app wipes local data and goes to sign-in.

error.not_in_your_area.description: Sync reject reason on EnrolFarmer (FA app).

error.otp_invalid.description: 400 otp_invalid on OTP verify. Pair with error.detail.attempts_left.

error.profile_already_complete.description: 409 on complete-profile; the app carries on to Home.

error.rate_limited.description: 429 rate_limited. Pair with error.detail.retry_after_seconds (from the Retry-After header).

error.registered_with_another_fa.description: Sync reject reason on EnrolFarmer (FA app).

error.timeout.description: App-side code: the request timed out.

error.unknown.description: Fallback for any code this app version does not know.

farmer.advice.ask_at_shop_body.description: F8b instruction (wireframe; the cashback sentence is dropped until Phase 2).

farmer.advice.ask_at_shop_label.description: F8b label above the salt name (wireframe "ASK FOR THIS AT THE SHOP").

farmer.advice.dealer_distance.description: Dealer distance; km is pre-formatted, e.g. 1.8.

farmer.advice.show_at_shop.description: F8a button that opens the full-screen card (wireframe).

farmer.advice.title.description: Neutral advice header while loading, pending or not found (promises neither a product nor a salt).

farmer.advice.voice_help_pending.description: Voice prompt for an advice item the FA has not filled in yet.

farmer.calendar.day.description: Progress line when the crop has no duration.

farmer.calendar.no_sowing_date.description: Season without a sowing date; only the FA can add it.

farmer.calendar.tasks_later.description: Shown in place of the task list (calendar module not built).

farmer.consent.agree.description: Primary button: grants the programme consent (wireframe).

farmer.consent.purpose.description: Programme purpose, shown above the three points (notice_version is bundled with this text).

farmer.consent.saved.description: Snackbar after the consent is stored.

farmer.consent.voice_help.description: Voice prompt that reads the whole consent notice (purpose first); audio_played is sent when it plays to the end.

farmer.consent.voice_help_declined.description: Voice prompt for the "Not now" sheet of the consent screen.

farmer.consents.changed_on.description: When the consent was last set.

farmer.consents.empty.description: Consents screen when the list came back empty; Try again below.

farmer.consents.voice_help.description: Voice prompt for the consents list.

farmer.consents.withdraw_body.description: Withdraw dialog body, under the purpose name.

farmer.consents.withdraw_programme_voice.description: Voice prompt for the withdraw dialog of the programme consent (with the warning).

farmer.consents.withdraw_programme_warni.description: Extra warning when withdrawing the programme consent.

farmer.consents.withdraw_voice.description: Voice prompt for the withdraw-consent dialog (any purpose but programme).

farmer.farm.change_name_voice.description: Voice prompt for the change-name dialog.

farmer.farm.plot.description: Default plot name when the plot has no label (wireframe "పొలం 1").

farmer.farm.plots.description: Section header above the plot cards.

farmer.farm.sign_out_voice.description: Voice prompt for the sign-out confirmation.

farmer.farm.sows_on.description: Plot row and crop calendar line when the sowing date is still ahead (counterpart of sown_on).

farmer.farm.village_change_note.description: Note under the village (not editable here).

farmer.fas.call_failed.description: Snack bar when the phone has no dialer (tablet); shows the number to call by hand. Also used on Home.

farmer.fas.callback_sent_body.description: Call-back sent line (wireframe "Suresh will call you today").

farmer.fas.lead.description: Badge on the lead FA for the area.

farmer.fas.whatsapp_failed.description: Snack bar when WhatsApp could not be opened.

farmer.fas.whatsapp_message.description: Text pre-filled in the WhatsApp chat (wa.me ?text=).

farmer.fas.working_hours.description: FA card line; hours text comes from the server.

farmer.fas.your_fa.description: Badge on the farmer's own FA (wireframe).

farmer.home.area.description: Plot area as acres and guntas, spelled out; a zero part is left out ("2 ఎకరాలు", "20 గుంటలు", "2 ఎకరాలు 20 గుంటలు").

farmer.home.locked_body.description: Sheet body for a locked tile.

farmer.home.locked_title.description: Sheet shown when a locked tile is tapped.

farmer.home.locked_voice.description: Voice prompt for the coming-soon sheet of a locked Home tile.

farmer.home.look_for_fas.description: Link from the FA card to F3.

farmer.home.next_visit.description: Label above the next visit date (wireframe F4).

farmer.home.no_next_visit.description: Shown when there is no planned visit.

farmer.home.no_plot_body.description: Home card body when the farmer has no plot yet; the button opens My farm.

farmer.home.no_plot_title.description: Home card when the farmer has no plot yet.

farmer.home.tile_weather.description: Home tile, locked until the feed exists (wireframe).

farmer.home.weather_soon.description: Weather card placeholder (feed not built; hidden in prod).

farmer.inbox.listened.description: Tag after the voice note played to the end.

farmer.inbox.new_count.description: Count next to the title (wireframe "3 new").

farmer.inbox.no_audio.description: Shown instead of Listen when audio_url is null.

farmer.inbox.no_audio_voice.description: Voice prompt on a notice that has no voice note of its own (audio_url is null).

farmer.login.account_paused.description: Shown after sign-in when farmer_status is inactive.

farmer.login.call_helpline.description: Button that dials the helpline (wireframe states).

farmer.login.change_number.description: Link back to the phone step.

farmer.login.no_otp.description: Link under the OTP boxes (wireframe states).

farmer.login.no_otp_help.description: Sheet shown for "OTP not received?". Voice OTP (call me) is not built, so the helpline is offered instead.

farmer.login.otp_autofill.description: Reserved for SMS autofill (not wired yet): hint under the OTP boxes once the app reads the SMS by itself.

farmer.login.otp_hint.description: Hint under the OTP boxes (no SMS autofill yet).

farmer.login.otp_sent_to.description: OTP step subtitle; phone is phone_masked from the server.

farmer.login.otp_waiting.description: Shown while SMS autofill waits for the OTP.

farmer.login.paused_title.description: Title of the account paused card (farmer_status inactive).

farmer.login.phone_hint.description: Phone field hint (+91 prefix is shown by the field).

farmer.login.phone_invalid.description: Inline error on the phone field.

farmer.login.resend_in.description: Resend countdown; time is m:ss, e.g. 0:24.

farmer.login.send_otp.description: Primary button on the phone step.

farmer.login.tagline.description: Tag line under the app name on the phone step.

farmer.login.use_sim_number.description: Phone number hint picker button (wireframe "From SIM").

farmer.login.verify.description: Primary button on the OTP step.

farmer.login.voice_help_no_otp.description: Voice prompt for the "OTP not received?" sheet.

farmer.login.voice_help_otp.description: Voice prompt for the OTP step (Listen button).

farmer.login.voice_help_paused.description: Voice prompt for the account paused screen (Listen button).

farmer.login.voice_help_phone.description: Voice prompt for the phone step (Listen button).

farmer.name.required.description: Inline error when the name is blank.

farmer.name.voice_help.description: Voice prompt for the name step.

farmer.plot_add.area_invalid.description: Inline error: no area typed (0 acres and 0 guntas).

farmer.plot_add.area_too_big.description: Inline error: area above the app's cap for one field (maxPlotAcres, below the API's 10000).

farmer.plot_add.no_location.description: Location step when neither the village nor another plot has a location.

farmer.plot_add.saved.description: Snackbar after the plot is saved.

farmer.plot_add.village_pin_body.description: Location step body while GPS is not wired.

farmer.plot_add.village_pin_title.description: Location step title while GPS is not wired: the village location is used as the pin.

farmer.plot_add.voice_help_area.description: Voice prompt for the area step.

farmer.plot_add.voice_help_label.description: Voice prompt for the field name step.

farmer.plot_add.voice_help_pin.description: Voice prompt for the pin step.

farmer.plot_add.voice_help_village_pin.description: Voice prompt for the location step while GPS is not wired.

farmer.season_close.closed.description: Snackbar after the season is closed.

farmer.season_start.current.description: Tag on the current season code.

farmer.season_start.season_label.description: Season picker option, e.g. "రబీ 2026-27"; season from enum.season_kind.

farmer.season_start.started.description: Snackbar after the season is saved.

farmer.state.error_voice.description: Voice prompt for the error card.

farmer.state.no_advice_voice.description: Voice prompt for the empty inbox.

farmer.state.no_fa_voice.description: Voice prompt for the no-FA card.

farmer.state.no_visits_voice.description: Voice prompt for the no-visits card.

farmer.state.offline_body.description: Offline card body (wireframe "Showing saved ... from 7:00 am").

farmer.state.offline_nothing_voice.description: Voice prompt for the offline card when nothing is saved on the phone.

farmer.state.offline_voice.description: Voice prompt for the offline banner shown over saved details (Home).

farmer.village.browse.description: Button that opens the district > mandal > village browser.

farmer.village.confirm.description: Confirm button after choosing a village.

farmer.village.result_area.description: Second line of a village search result.

farmer.village.voice_help.description: Voice prompt for the village picker.

farmer.visits.call_before.description: Next visit banner note (wireframe "Suresh will call before coming").

farmer.visits.photos.description: Photo count on a visit row.

farmer.visits.shanmukha_product.description: Tag on an advised Shanmukha product (wireframe).

farmer.visits.stage.description: Crop stage at the visit; stage name comes from the server. Telugu stage names already include the word ("పూత దశ"), English ones don't ("Flowering"), so only English adds it.
